info.name: Garage API Collection
info.description:
Complete API collection for the Garage management system.
Base URL variable: {{base_url}} (default: http://localhost:3000/api)

Tip: Login endpoints have test scripts that auto-save tokens to collection variables.

request.description: Check if the API server is running.
Login as admin. Returns JWT token + role=SuperAdmin.
Login as company user. Returns JWT token + role from company_users → roles.
Send as multipart/form-data. Logo is optional.
